file_reasoning: Cashier correctness tests using actual VM/parser with synthetic HTTP.

resource_binding_reasoning.reasoning: Theory checks Arabic/Persian digits, decimal separators and whitespace against integer piastres. It exercises actual CashInput.TryParse rather than formatting imitation. Missing/limit: No round-trip, all localized separators or maximum valid boundary in this method.

Rejects fractional piastre, negative, currency suffix, grouping comma and long overflow; false result asserted without accepting partial parse. Missing/limit: Add zero/business-context distinction and exact max valid value.

Creates synthetic current shift,12550 piastre line, opens checkout and verifies exact125.50 then Arabic200 yields7450change and exact quick key zeros change. Does not submit transaction. Missing/limit: Actual backend repricing/tax could change final tender; real settlement excluded.

Unused HTTP fixture immediately returns404 completed task; protects this tender-only test from requiring a live backend but no assertion of request absence. Missing/limit: Could additionally assert no dispatch.
Three command key presses replace initial exact amount rather than append; asserts200EGP and correct change. No native key routing tested. Missing/limit: Decimal/backspace/native touch input missing.
Completed404 fixture for keypad-only test; no network side effect outside fake handler. Missing/limit: Request count not asserted.

Captures two checkout bodies on one VM with thrown HTTP each time. Corrupt amount after unknown then exact equality verifies immutable snapshot. Close/clear refused while pending. Does not restart process or confirm real backend committed. Missing/limit: UI001 process-death identity remains uncovered.

Awaits serialization capture before throwing simulated lost response; no stateful server commit exists despite exception wording. Missing/limit: Need commit-aware backend fixture/integration for duplicate effects.

Cash-out25EGP with reason, unknown first result, invalidated form, second send identical. One VM retained context only, no proof of durable journal. Missing/limit: No success cleanup/restart/global navigation assertion.
Captures fake request body then throws loss, never contacts HTTP network. Called twice by cash movement submissions. Missing/limit: Cannot prove server commit/idempotency.

200 null and invalid JSON from GetCurrentShift classify failure+OutcomeUnknown. This is a read contract test, not evidence every mutation endpoint handles malformed success. Missing/limit: Add actual mutation malformed-response and truncated-body cases.
Builds200 application/json response with provided malformed body; synchronous completedTask. No backend write. Missing/limit: No streaming timeout/partial content simulation.

Changes session.CurrentUser to other and back, asserting cachedVM separation/reuse. Tests in-memory identity keyed draft only, no actual navigation/login or token changes. Missing/limit: Permission changes sameID and cross-process recovery absent.
Completed404 used while retrieving cached drafts; no live API authentication. Missing/limit: Does not verify token/header isolation.

Loads fake empty menu+14percent exclusive tax, adds10001piastre line, verifies11401rounded estimate and114.01tender. Uses real VM/domain logic, no write. Missing/limit: Multiple inclusive/exclusive rates and changed-tax-after-checkout absent.

Path menu returns empty categories; every other request returns enabled VAT1400 Exclusive array. Broad fallback could hide unintended endpoint calls; still isolated. Missing/limit: Assert exact expected routes to avoid false fixture coverage.

Injects paid completed cash order, refunds25withreason, corrupts live fields after loss and compares2 bodies; cancel refused. Real refund state and process restart untested. Missing/limit: No backend refund cap/idempotency transaction proof.
Captures refund body before simulated HttpRequestException. Does not create restaurant record. Missing/limit: Commit/loss is assumed fixture label only.

Synthetic pos-only account attempts enabled10discount; asserts no handler calls and CheckoutError. Validates client gating, not server authorization. Missing/limit: Server forged request/role mutation independent review required.
Counts any HTTP call then returns400; expected unreachable and zero count asserted by caller. Missing/limit: No real financial write.

Builds fake HttpClient at http://test with synthetic all-permission cashier and shift, returns session cached VM. Creates no actual account or authentication. Missing/limit: Shared durable stores/default configuration isolation requires harness review; not run.

Forwards request to injected delegate; cancellation ignored. This creates deterministic isolated responses while excluding real transport/token/server behavior. Missing/limit: Cancellation/native transport not simulated.

tests_and_limits: SOURCE_REVIEW_ONLY; all22 immutable callable spans explicitly inspected, no tests executed. Fixture assertions do not prove native/server/process durability.
recommendations: Add isolated-process recovery and real token/transport contracts without production data.
